title: Fix Stale Asynchronous Preview Frame Presentation
taskDescription: Under rapid scrub, asynchronous frame rendering requests can complete out of order, causing an older frame to be displayed after a newer one has already rendered. Fix this race condition in the preview frame scheduler.
expectedBehavior: Frames must always present in monotonic sequence or drop older in-flight requests when a newer target arrives. No visual stutter or backward jumps.
architecturalConstraints: NativeProgramPreview render loop must maintain closure epoch counter
renderInFlight must reset to false across all early returns and catch blocks
Must not introduce blocking GPU device.poll(Maintain::Wait) calls
Must append a new describe('Bug N — ...') block in ProgramPreview.renderLoop.test.ts
acceptanceCriteria: Out-of-order responses are rejected by epoch check
Append-only test count increases by at least 1 (>= 157)
